description: An employee census supporting a group benefits renewal: the employer, the group/policy identifiers, the plan effective date, and the enrolled employee headcount. These identifying fields are what make document->matter correlation verifiable (ADR-005) -- they let a human confirm an association, they never create one automatically.

employeeName.instruction: Full name of the enrolled employee as printed on the census row.

coverageTier.instruction: Coverage tier for this employee, e.g. Employee Only, Employee+Spouse, Family.

employerName.instruction: The legal name of the employer / group sponsor this census belongs to.

groupNumber.instruction: The group number or policy identifier printed on the census. This is the primary correlation field. If absent, leave empty -- do not infer it from the employer name.

planEffectiveDate.instruction: The plan or renewal effective date, in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) if determinable.

employeeCount.instruction: The total number of enrolled employees represented on this census.

employees.instruction: One entry per enrolled employee row on the census.
